free_tier.stated: Free Sandbox at USD 0: full API access, a shared phone number, up to 10 verified contacts, inbound-first messaging, CLI and SDK support, community support, no dedicated number, no outbound messaging and no webhooks or callbacks; no credit card required
free_tier.notes: The meter is the count of verified contacts, capped at 10; the sandbox cannot initiate outbound messages.

per_object_cap.stated: media sent through the API is capped at 100 MB for iMessage and 5 MB for SMS; a message body is capped at 18,996 characters
per_object_cap.notes: The vendor states 100 MB and 5 MB; no exact byte count is published.

retention.stated: not stated on the pricing, API, limits or terms pages read

egress.terms: no per-message fees; messages, media and delivery receipts are returned by REST API or POSTed to a webhook, but the free sandbox has no webhooks or callbacks, so results are read by polling the API

interface_detail: a REST API at https://api.sendblue.com with an official CLI, Node.js and Python SDKs, MCP server and webhooks on paid tiers
tooling: REST API, @sendblue/cli, Node.js and Python SDKs and an MCP server for AI editors
chaining: a hosted iMessage, SMS and RCS send-and-receive endpoint for agents; it is inbound-first on the free sandbox and needs a verified contact before a reply can be sent

limits.value: a contact must text the shared sandbox number once before the account can message that contact; no outbound messaging on the free sandbox
10 verified contacts on the free sandbox; the AI Agent tier lists 1,000 inbound contacts a day
one message a second per dedicated number; the Contacts API takes 100 requests per 10 seconds; the queue holds 1,500 messages and answers 429 beyond it
account creation needs a company name, first name, company email, phone number and a referral answer

limits_note: Dynamic account-level quotas and sender pools apply beyond the published per-line rates.
binding_note: The sandbox cannot send to a contact until that contact messages the shared number first, and it has no webhooks, so the write gate binds before the 10-contact cap or the per-second rate.

identity_cost.detail: The pricing page says no credit card is required; the account form asks for company name, first name, company email, phone number and a referral answer; the CLI setup asks for an email verification code. The quickstart labels the free tier no credit card required.

reliability_note: the sandbox uses a shared number with no webhooks, and a 429 is returned once the 1,500-message queue is full; outbound to unverified contacts is rejected
confidence_note: Pricing, contact cap, outbound restriction, sign-up fields, REST interface, base URL and rate limits were read and quoted on 2026-11-24; no signup or paid tier was entered.
